children.text: #Breaking: Google & Yahoo announce a brand new email authentication requirement for bulk email

children: As a Shopify store owner, recently you must have received such an email from Shopify with subject line stating

children.text: Authenticate and add a DMARC record to continue sending emails from your domain’

children: If yes and you are not quite sure how to fix this then let me explain to you what does it mean and how to fix it.

children.text: What does the above email mean to you?

children: Recently Google and yahoo announced that starting in the first quarter of 2024, domain owners who send bulk email for the promotion of their businesses to Google/ Yahoo email addresses would be required to authenticate their emails. This, in turn, would ensure that receivers can easily unsubscribe from receiving emails that do not interest them and maintain a less spammy inbox.
As per the announcement, merchants need to take action before February 1 2024 and have to authenticate their domain email if you like to continue to send email from your branded email address.

Shopify to send emails for your domain.
Have a DMARC policy for your domain, with a minimum p=none policy setting.
